After the author added a "novice lecturer" tag, the AI kept limiting opportunities to the training track, reinforcing the stereotype and even leading the author to gradually identify with this single identity. This reflection is a warning for heavy Agent users: in human-AI coexistence, don't let AI's memory box in your broader potential.
